reason: The README describes a DSH Web GUI marketplace for discovering GitHub plugins and skills, with search, metadata browsing, installation, updates, and removal. It can clone repositories, modify local DSH files and registrations, execute third-party installation or npm scripts, handle user-provided environment values, and access GitHub and WebDAV, so human review is appropriate for its R2 risk profile.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 中浏览、搜索、安装、更新和卸载来自 GitHub 的 DSH 插件与通用 Skills。
summaries.en: Browse, search, install, update, and uninstall DSH plugins and general skills from GitHub within the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.

capabilities: Browse and search GitHub plugin and skill metadata
Clone repositories from GitHub
Install, update, and uninstall third-party plugins, skills, and agent presets
Execute third-party shell, PowerShell, and npm lifecycle scripts after confirmation
Write plugin files, registrations, installation records, and environment configuration
Use user-provided API keys, tokens, and secrets during installation
Read from and write backups to WebDAV
Create GitHub issues for installation feedback
Self-update the marketplace plugin
